newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss shares seen firmer in technical reaction.
newsitem.headline: Swiss shares seen firmer in technical reaction.

text.p: 0710 GMT - Swiss shares are expected to open firmer in a technical reaction to yesterday's losses, dealers said.
Stronger U.S. markets overnight, a firmer dollar and rising bond futures gave support, they said.
But trading volume was expected to be low, with interest centered on dollar-sensitive stocks and index heavywheights.
A SMI index, calculated by Bank Leu on pre-bourse prices, was 34.1 points firmer at 5,876.2.
Cyclical shares Rieter profited from Saurer's half year figures, which were released on Tuesday, and jumped 21 francs to 656.
So did the shares of Georg Fischer, which rose 56 francs to 2,246, and Oerlikon-Buehrle, which advanced 7.75 francs to 158.25.
Speciality chemicals Ciba and Clariant also saw gains. Clariant rose 18 francs to 1,147 and Ciba registered shares rose 1.25 francs to 141.75.
